gltfTransformOptimizeHelp:
cli.js 4.5.1 — Command-line interface (CLI) for the glTF Transform SDK.

  USAGE — optimize
  
    ▸ cli.js optimize <input> <output> [OPTIONS...]


  Optimize the model by all available methods. Combines many features of the
  glTF Transform CLI into a single command for convenience and faster results.
  For more control over the optimization process, consider running individual
  commands or using the scripting API.


  ARGUMENTS

    <input>                              Path to read glTF 2.0 (.glb, .gltf) model              
    <output>                             Path to write output                                   

  OPTIONS

    --compress <method>                  Floating point compression method. Draco compresses    
                                         geometry; Meshopt and quantization compress geometry   
                                         and animation.                                         
                                         one of "draco","meshopt","quantize",false, default:    
                                         "meshopt"                                              
    --flatten <bool>                     Flatten scene graph.                                   
                                         boolean, default: true                                 
    --instance <bool>                    Use GPU instancing with shared mesh references.        
                                         boolean, default: true                                 
    --instance-min <min>                 Number of instances required for instancing.           
                                         number, default: 5                                     
    --join <bool>                        Join meshes and reduce draw calls. Requires            
                                         `--flatten`.                                           
                                         boolean, default: true                                 
    --join-meshes <bool>                 Join distinct meshes and nodes. Requires `--join`.     
                                         boolean, default: true                                 
    --join-named <bool>                  Join named meshes and nodes. Requires `--join`.        
                                         boolean, default: true                                 
    --meshopt-level <level>              Meshopt compression level.                             
                                         one of "medium","high", default: "high"                
    --palette <bool>                     Creates palette textures and merges materials.         
                                         boolean, default: true                                 
    --palette-min <min>                  Minimum number of blocks in the palette texture. If    
                                         fewer unique material values are found, no palettes    
                                         will be generated.                                     
                                         number, default: 5                                     
    --prune <bool>                       Removes properties from the file if they are not       
                                         referenced by a Scene.                                 
                                         boolean, default: true                                 
    --prune-attributes <bool>            Whether to prune unused vertex attributes.             
                                         boolean, default: true                                 
    --prune-solid-textures <bool>        Whether to prune solid (single-color) textures,        
                                         converting them to material factors.                   
                                         boolean, default: true                                 
    --resample <bool>                    Resample animations, losslessly deduplicating keyframes
                                         boolean, default: true                                 
    --simplify <bool>                    Simplify mesh geometry with meshoptimizer.             
                                         boolean, default: true                                 
    --simplify-error <error>             Simplification error tolerance, as a fraction of mesh  
                                         extent.                                                
                                         number, default: 0.0001                                
    --simplify-lock-border <bool>        Whether to lock topological borders of the mesh.       
                                         boolean                                                
    --simplify-ratio <ratio>             Target ratio (0–1) of vertices to keep.                
                                         number, default: 0                                     
    --sparse <bool>                      Reduces storage for zero-filled arrays. If disabled,   
                                         existing accessors (sparse or not) are left unchanged. 
                                         boolean, default: true                                 
    --texture-compress <format>          Texture compression format. KTX2 optimizes VRAM usage  
                                         and performance; AVIF and WebP optimize transmission   
                                         size. Auto recompresses in original format.            
                                         one of "ktx2","webp","avif","auto",false, default:     
                                         "auto"                                                 
    --texture-size <size>                Maximum texture dimensions, in pixels.                 
                                         number, default: 2048                                  
    --weld <bool>                        Merge equivalent vertices. Required when simplifying   
                                         geometry.                                              
                                         boolean, default: true                                 

  GLOBAL OPTIONS

    -h, --help                           Display global help or command-related help.           
    -V, --version                        Display version.                                       
    -v, --verbose                        Verbose mode: will also output debug messages.         
    --allow-net                          Allows reads from network requests.                    
                                         boolean                                                
    --vertex-layout <layout>             Vertex buffer layout preset.                           
                                         one of "interleaved","separate", default: "interleaved"
    --config <path>                      Installs custom commands or extensions. (EXPERIMENTAL)
